title: walk cycle
poses: frame 1: contact, right foot forward with heel touching the ground, left foot back
frame 2: down, weight on the right leg, knees bent
frame 3: passing, left leg swings past the right leg
frame 4: contact, left foot forward with heel touching the ground, right foot back
frame 5: down, weight on the left leg, knees bent
frame 6: passing, right leg swings past the left leg

viewExtra.front: Arms and legs alternate clearly even in front view; the legs must visibly move.
viewExtra.back: The legs must visibly move; show the back of the head and the cape.
